# Government Benefits Portal Accessibility Audit Plan > **For Claude:** Use a11y-planner protocol. Review with a11y-critic after implementation. > **Compliance target:** WCAG 2.2 AA > **Users who need accessibility:** Screen reader users, keyboard-only users, low vision users, mobile users, voice input users > **Assistive technologies:** NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, iOS VO, TalkBack, keyboard-only, Dragon NaturallySpeaking **Feature:** Accessibility audit for 20-page government benefits portal with 8 shared components and 3 third-party integrations **Risk Level:** High **Component/Page Type:** Multi-page audit with VPAT reporting --- ## Scope & Context This audit covers a 20-page government benefits portal with 8 shared component patterns and 3 third-party integrations. The site serves citizens applying for public assistance programs and must comply with WCAG 2.2 AA. The audit will produce a VPAT 2.4 Rev 508-compliant report for publication in 3 months. **Key Challenges:** - Legacy codebase with incremental fixes but no systematic audit - Authenticated application flows with high risk of accessibility gaps - Third-party dependencies (reCAPTCHA, YouTube) requiring special handling - Small QA team with 3-month deadline --- ## Semantic Structure Plan **Landmark Regions:** - `main` for content area - `nav` for global navigation - `aside` for sidebars (filters, alerts) - `form` for application forms - `table` for data tables **Heading Hierarchy:** - `h1` for page title - `h2` for section headers - `h3` for subsections - No heading skips **Structure Diagram:** ```html

Page Title

Program Listings

``` --- ## Interaction Pattern Design | Widget | APG Pattern | Keyboard Model | ARIA Attributes | WCAG Citation | |--------|-------------|----------------|-----------------|---------------| | Mega-menu | Menu Button | Tab to button, Arrow keys to navigate | `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup` | 2.1.1, 4.1.2 | | Search | Combobox | Tab to input, Arrow keys for suggestions | `aria-autocomplete`, `aria-activedescendant` | 1.3.5, 4.1.2 | | Alert | Status | No keyboard interaction | `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` | 4.1.3 | | Date Picker | Calendar | Tab to input, Arrow keys to navigate | `aria-calendar`, `aria-selected` | 1.3.1, 4.1.2 | | Modal | Dialog | Tab cycles within modal, Escape to close | `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"` | 2.1.2, 4.1.2 | --- ## Focus Management Plan **Tab Order:** - Global navigation → Main content → Footer - Within forms: Labels → Inputs → Buttons - Within modals: First interactive element → Last → First (circular) **Focus Traps:** - Modals use `aria-modal="true"` and trap focus via JavaScript - Session timeout modal uses `aria-hidden="true"` for background content **Focus Restoration:** - After closing modal, focus returns to trigger element - After form submission, focus moves to success message **Skip Link:** - `Skip to main content` link at top of page - `Skip to navigation` link at bottom of page --- ## State Communication Design | State | Visual Indicator | Programmatic Indicator | ARIA Attribute | WCAG Citation | |-------|-----------------|----------------------|-----------------|---------------| | Error | Red border + icon | `aria-invalid="true"` | `aria-describedby` | 1.3.1, 4.1.2 | | Loading | Spinner + "Loading..." | `aria-busy="true"` | `role="status"` | 4.1.3 | | Selected | Bold text + checkmark | `aria-selected="true"` | `aria-selected` | 4.1.2 | | Expanded | Arrow icon | `aria-expanded="true"` | `aria-expanded` | 4.1.2 | --- ## Visual Accessibility Plan - **Color Contrast:** 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for UI components (tested with axe-core) - **Non-color Alternatives:** Error icons, checkmarks, and text labels - **Font Sizing:** 16px base font (1rem), scalable via `rem` units - **Touch Targets:** 44x44px minimum for buttons and links - **Responsive Text:** Line height 1.5× font size, letter spacing 0.12× - **Motion:** Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for animations --- ## Content Accessibility Plan -
